svg.title: Gaussian process: prior and posterior
svg.desc: Two panels. Left: three functions sampled from a zero-mean GP prior with an RBF kernel and a teal 95 percent band of constant width. Right: the posterior after five noise-free observations; the mean passes through the red points and the band shrinks to nothing at them and widens between and beyond them.
svg.text: Teal line: mean. Teal band: mean plus or minus 2 standard deviations (return_std=True). Red dots: training points.
Far from the data the posterior falls back to the prior: wide band, mean near zero.
